segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Deputy Minority Leader Cendaña, you are recognized.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sa totoo lamang po, kasama po ako dun sa second round dapat ng pagtatanong from the minority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So ako po yung una, pero after I think around 29 members of the majority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ganyan po yung karami ng mga members of the House na gusto po magbigay ng input, magtanong sa DOH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kasi gusto po natin tiyakin yung tagumpay of the DOH under the leadership of Secretary Mercado

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: and of course the success of the PhilHealth under the leadership of President-CEO Beverly Ho.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Napakalaga po sa amin na magtagumpay ang inyong leadership, not because lang para lang sa administrasyon, kundi para po sa sambayan ng Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kaya po, with the indulgence of the members of the House who have expressed,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: their intent to raise questions and issues to the Secretary of the Department of Health,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: I move to suspend consideration of the proposed budget of the Department of Health,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: subject to its resumption on Monday at a time to be determined by the Chairperson of the Committee on Appropriations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: I so move, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: It has been moved and duly seconded to suspend consideration of the proposed budget of the DOH

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: subject to its resumption on Monday, September 7, at a time to be determined by the Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Is there any objection? Hearing none, the motion is approved.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Cong [unclear], please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: I move that we suspend the committee hearing here at the Ramualdez Hall on House Bill No. 10858 until tomorrow, September 3, 2026, at 9 a.m.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: I so move, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Second, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: It has been moved and duly seconded. Is there any objection? Hearing none, the Chair, the Committee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Hearing on House Bill No. 10858 here at the Ramualdez Hall is hereby suspended until tomorrow, 9 a.m.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Until tomorrow, 9 a.m.
